capabilities: import Xiaohongshu notes from pasted share links or share text
download or embed note images and videos
organize imported notes into user-defined category folders
configure default folder, media download, and category settings
extras: The README includes a troubleshooting section (URL validation, failed imports, media download issues, modal layout with custom themes) and notes imported notes must be public and accessible.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull the content, media, and tags of a Xiaohongshu post into the vault as an organized note.
summary: Imports Xiaohongshu (RedNote) notes from share links into categorized Markdown files, with images, videos, tags, and frontmatter metadata.
